purpose: Production-touching actions wait here. Nothing in this file executes itself; an agent may prepare an action and record it, but only Roger authorizes it, and execution happens afterwards in one of his two daily windows.
enforcementNote: Migrations numbered at or above queueEnforcedFromPhase must have an entry here. Earlier phases predate the queue and are not retroactively enforced; their applied state must be proven by object presence, because the Supabase migration ledger holds only a baseline row. An entry whose artifacts have moved to another branch records that branch and PR rather than an in-tree path.

entries.title: Apply phase-49 durable packet render jobs and artifact-gated credit
entries.why: A sponsored packet credit is currently consumed with no validated artifact in existence. packet/generate/route.ts records a credit when packetStatus reaches 'ready', and 'ready' is produced by an in-memory text/plain string with no render, no storage write and no read-back. This migration makes credit movement impossible without stored, checksummed bytes. The migration stays in the canonical supabase/ directory: relocating it would create a fake distinction between the code and the schema it requires.
entries.riskNote: Additive and forward-only. Creates three new tables, one trigger and two functions. Alters no existing table, drops nothing, and backfills nothing. No application code reads these objects yet, so applying it changes no runtime behaviour on its own.
preconditions: phase-48-rcap-document-artifact-storage.sql applied, or its absence accepted — phase 49 takes no foreign key on rcap_document_artifacts and applies independently
evidence: Applies cleanly to a fresh PostgreSQL 16 cluster
Mutation-tested: stripping the artifact_validated gate turns the suite red
SQL, shared fixture and TypeScript contract all agree; drift mutation-tested on both sides
entries.rollback: Documented at the foot of the migration: drop the two functions, the two credit tables, the trigger and its function, then packet_render_jobs. Additive, so no pre-existing row is affected.
blocks: Wiring packet-generation.ts to the job queue. Application code must not reference these objects before the migration is applied to the target environment.
doesNotAuthorize: any wildcard, prefix, directory or future-migration exception
any unrelated policy, function, seed, config or schema change
enabling credits on a successful SQL exit without post-apply read-back
later Supabase work of any kind
entries.voidsOn: Any change to either authorized path or its bytes voids this authorization and returns the item to the queue.

environmentConditions.applyProduction: authorized conditionally — only after staging read-back and behaviour checks pass; no second business authorization required unless a path or its bytes change

statusVocabulary.authorized_scoped: authorized for some environments and still queued for others; see scopedAuthorization

exactPathAuthorizationNote: supabase/ remains globally forbidden by assertSourceEngineChangeScope. An entry may name authorizedPaths with matching authorizedSha256, which permits those exact files at those exact bytes and nothing else. This distinguishes an unauthorized production change from a specifically approved one; it does not widen the prefix.
